data.name: Severed Light
data.detailed_description:
Severed Light is a dark action RPG and a love letter to the old-school ARPGs we grew up with.
Set in the fractured world of Valdris, you play a nameless hero trying to rebuild a kingdom of men, mer, and beasts — while something ancient and hungry works within to stop you.

Two Continents to Explore

The vibrant lands of Valdris and the frigid wastes of the Kythra Frostlands. Both maps have hand-crafted towns, biomes, dungeons, rivers, quests, and points of interest. Procedural dungeons and random events mean every playthrough feels familiar but never the same.

Theory Crafting at Lv.1

5 classes, each with 5 skills right out of the gate. No waiting around to feel powerful. Pick what you like, invest, evolve.

Light or Darkness 

Defeat the many world bosses and collect their Mantles of Darkness. Equip them and let the power consume you like it did your enemies — or destroy them and rid the world of evil forever. The main quest takes you to the gates of Tarantus to face the dark lord who destroyed everything.


Loot for Days

D2-style tiered drops with randomized prefixes and suffixes. Magic, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Uniques. All hand-crafted with lore attached and new stuff to see as you level up. 30+ helmets, pauldrons, gloves, boots, pants, armor, shields, rings, swords, bows and more.

Build a base... or a Kingdom

Harvest building materials out in the world or buy them in town. Build wherever you want — a small hunting cabin in the frostlands, a fortress by the sea, whatever. It's your world.


Severed Light is in Early Access. The core world is fully playable — the rest is being built in the open.

data.short_description: Severed Light is an open world ARPG where you quest, loot, battle, and build your way to a world free from the beasts and demons that have overtaken the world of Valdris.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics w/ WebGL 1.0 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible integrated audio
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Internet not required after install
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5, 2.5 GHz+ quad-core
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible stereo sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad supported. 1280×720 display or higher recommended.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 dual-core or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris / Apple Silicon integrated
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio (built-in)
  • Additional Notes: Internet not required after install
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio (built-in)
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad supported. 1280×720 display or higher recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: Severed Light contains fantasy violence including combat, weapons, undead enemies, and player death. Enemies can break apart into pieces upon death and leave pools of blood. All violence is depicted in a pixel art style. Ontop of violence there are also two gambling mini-games to help earn in-game gold and rarer items.
